scientific_integrity: The theorem is an explicit Hasse-Witt and Newton-slope calculation; it invokes the classical Jacobi-sum/Stickelberger valuation theorem. Numerical tests do not substitute for the symbolic determinant argument.
scientific_limitations: Only the marked one-parameter genus-four cyclic trigonal family in geometric characteristic 13 is classified.
The full zeta function is not computed; the Jacobi-sum valuation theorem is an external mathematical input.
A previously published equivalent specialized calculation is a residual priority possibility.
title: The unique nonordinary fiber of a genus-four cyclic-trigonal pencil in characteristic thirteen
